environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with connection routed through PgBouncer (transaction mode). The database role 'appuser_ro' is configured with a restricted search_path and connected via pg_hba.conf entry that enforces the role. Additionally, a PostgreSQL event trigger (ddl_command_end) and row-level security policy exist but are not relevant here. The critical control: the RDS instance has a custom parameter group with 'pgaudit.log' enabled, and the db role used at runtime is granted ONLY: GRANT SELECT ON reports TO appuser_ro; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO appuser_ro; No INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE. The role also has statement_timeout set to 200ms via ALTER ROLE appuser_ro SET statement_timeout = '200ms'. PgBouncer connects as appuser_ro exclusively.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15 with custom parameter group (pgaudit.log=all, log_statement=all)
config.db_connection: PgBouncer 1.21 in transaction mode, server-side role: appuser_ro
config.db_user_permissions: GRANT SELECT ON reports TO appuser_ro; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO appuser_ro; -- no other grants
config.network: ECS Fargate awsvpc, ALB security group allows inbound 443
